annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) – General approach – Statement by Germany
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) – General approach – Statement by Germany
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of the European Union (General Secretariat; statement by Germany)
annotation.venue: Council of the European Union document register
annotation.summary_en: Council note (25 November 2022) transmitting Germany's statement to the minutes on the AI Act general approach. Germany supports the Presidency text for adoption at the 6 December 2022 Telecom Council but wants some aspects improved, referring to its written comments of 8 November 2022, for the trilogue negotiations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Germany supports the Presidency's text for the general approach on 6 December 2022.
Germany sees need for improvements on certain aspects, citing its written comments of 8 November 2022.
Germany expects these aspects to be considered in trilogues with the Commission and Parliament.
